rules: The player declares biography and evidence, not a numeric skill value.
Starting capability is derived from duration, frequency, recency, instruction, certification and plausible experience.
A certification may constrain or support a claim but does not replace capability evidence.
Multiple activities are allowed only when the combined chronology remains plausible.
Hobbies and interests may later become high-level capabilities through sustained in-world practice.
Professional specialization is not required for a hobby or cross-domain competence to improve.
